name: Eldritch Secrets
body:
The deity to which you have pledged your loyalty is a patron of witches too and lent you some of their power.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, ability to cast 1st-level divine spells.

Benefit: Pick a patron from the witch patrons list. It must be suitable for your alignment, ethics, and deity (GM’s discretion). You add that patron’s granted spells to your spell list and spells known at the appropriate levels. Once chosen, the patron cannot be changed. If you have access to witch hexes and your patron grants any special hexes, you gain access to those hexes, but you still have to meet any other prerequisites to select them.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
